name: io.github.Shicodiez/crypto-regime-mcp
title: Crypto Regime MCP
description: Crypto trend, regime, indicators, stats, scan and perps; 15 tools; credits or x402.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List supported crypto assets and product ids for signal-api. Use this first to discover valid `asset` values for get_trend/get_regime and to see prices. Free.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Return the full signal-api catalog: active products, types, params, prices and descriptions. Use when you need the complete product list or metadata. Free.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Get a free sample of the last completed daily trend and regime for BTC or ETH. The sample is delayed by one day: today's live data and the other assets are paid. Free, limited to 60 calls/hour per IP.

asset.description: Asset symbol. Only BTC and ETH are available for free samples.

tools.name: get_x402_radar
tools.description: Daily public x402 market radar: top services by on-chain buyers, USDC revenue and repeat buyers, categories and listed prices. Aggregated public data only. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_x402_trust
tools.description: Technical check for one measured x402 resource: responds, valid 402 (v1/v2), payment header size, advertised vs Bazaar price, networks, response time, 7-day availability and on-chain sales. Mide solo si el servicio responde y cobra como anuncia. No evalúa si es honesto ni seguro, ni lo que entrega tras pagar. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

url.description: Exact x402 resource URL measured in the daily technical check.

tools.name: get_x402_trust_top
tools.description: Technical check of the top measured x402 services with availability, valid 402, payable header, price coherence, on-chain sales, a 0-100 score and verdict. Mide solo si el servicio responde y cobra como anuncia. No evalúa si es honesto ni seguro, ni lo que entrega tras pagar. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Get the combined daily trend signal for the default basket (BTC + ETH): signal (LONG/FLAT), exposure, SMA50, 30-day volatility, close and dates. Use when you need the overall market stance. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_market_scan
tools.description: One call to see what is strong/weak now: every catalog asset with trend, regime, RSI14, 7d/30d returns and distance to the 30d high/low, plus top-5 most bullish/bearish, RSI overbought/oversold and regime counts. Paid: $0.05 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: get_trend
tools.description: Get the daily trend signal for one crypto asset: signal (LONG/FLAT), exposure, SMA50, 30-day volatility, close and dates. Use when you need a directional/exposure view for a specific asset. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Discover valid assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or trend-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.

tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Get the market regime for one crypto asset: trend (bullish/bearish/lateral), volatility (low/medium/high/unknown), SMA50 slope, 30-day volatility, close and dates. Use when you need a regime/volatility classification rather than a trade signal. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Discover valid assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or regime-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.

tools.name: get_regime_stats
tools.description: Get historical regime statistics for one crypto asset: episode counts, mean/median 7/14/30-day returns, hit rate, drawdown and episode-bootstrap confidence intervals. This is historical statistics, not a prediction or financial advice. Universe: current catalog assets (survivorship bias). Groups with fewer than 20 episodes are marked insufficient. Paid: $0.02 USDC per call via x402. Discover valid assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or regime-stats-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.description: Get calculated daily indicators for one crypto asset: RSI14, MACD(12,26,9), ATR14 absolute and percent, Bollinger(20,2) with %B, returns 7d/30d, 30d/90d highs and lows, and the price distance to each level. Returns only calculated values, never raw candles. Use when you need technical context or mean-reversion/volatility levels. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Discover assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or indicators-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.
